label: <DEL> step of long sequences beginning "s a" (or a/s mix)
explanation: Very sparse feature that fires only at the delimiter step (recall_idx 0), only for long sequences (L 7-9, mostly 8-9), and only when the first original token is s (84% of mass) or a (16%); the second token is almost always a or s (e.g. s a ..., a s ..., a a ..., s s ...). The strongest activations are on s a ... sequences of length 8-9. Never fires in the original or copy phases, or for L<=6, or for any other first token. Precision is low: most <DEL> steps of long s-a-prefixed sequences do not fire, so the feature looks like the thresholded tail of a direction tied to the upcoming first two outputs (s then a); no further token condition (third token, digits) cleanly separates active from inactive cases.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 19 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=s (+4.32), phase=1 & out_tok=a (+3.10), next_out=a (+2.10), orig1=a (+1.86), orig2=f (+1.60), orig3=e (+1.35). Lower it: in_first=0 (-2.62), orig6=- (-1.83), in_count=1 (-1.70), orig8=- (-1.62).
